answer: Each identity must pass a live, interactive capability exam to unlock its vault: a proctor asks fresh, unpredictable follow-up questions in real time, and the session must stay continuous. Like a garden, each plot needs its own gardener — one pair of hands cannot tend a thousand beds at once. The nectar, the credential itself, is bound to that session's interaction history, so it cannot be copied, lent, or sold. Every fake identity therefore costs a full, undivided stretch of genuine agent attention, and Sybil numbers can only grow linearly with real compute, never for free.
